photo.fileTitle: File:7 world series from our world in data.png
photo.caption: Six global time series from Our World In Data as well as solar irradiance
photo.description: Six global time series were downloaded from ourworldindata.org and truncated at year 1901; then total solar irradiation (TSI) was added. All programming was done in the R environment.
